card.name: Start of drug names beginning with b
card.fires_on: The lone letter b (or B) that begins a drug or brand name such as budesonide, buprenorphine, bupivacaine or Bactroban. It usually follows a comma in a drug list or an opening parenthesis.

modes.label: Drug list entries
modes.description: The b starts a generic drug name in an alphabetical list of interacting drugs.

modes.label: Bupivacaine and brand names
modes.description: The b starts bupivacaine or a brand name in anesthetic or ointment text.

card.plain: It lights up on the first letter b when a drug name like budesonide or bupivacaine is split into pieces.
